name: Dream In/Dream Out
source:
Bullied in school, neglected at home, nothing seemed to make her life worth anything. Rage and hatred bottled up inside her, slowly eating her up, and the only solace she can find is the magical world where she is the beloved queen inside her dream.

After bumping into a man who promised to grant her deepest wish, she slayed various monsters—the people who wronged her all these years—that threatened her kingdom in her dream. She later realized her action could kill the actual person in real life.

With her mighty Sword of Justice and reality-bending dream, the queen took her revenge. 

[From [url=https://eikitaraaaa.itch.io/dream-in-dream-out]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在学校受人欺负，在家里无人关心，她的人生似乎找不出一点有价值的东西。愤怒与仇恨闷在心里，慢慢将她吞噬。唯一的慰藉便是梦中的魔法世界：在那里，她是深受爱戴的女王。

一天，她遇到一个承诺能实现她心底愿望的男人。之后，她开始在梦里斩杀威胁王国的各种怪物——也就是那些年来伤害过她的人。后来她才意识到，自己在梦里的举动，真的会让现实中的人丧命。

凭借威力强大的正义之剑，以及足以扭转现实的梦，女王开始了复仇。
